_notes: วีรชน: gacha sidegrades, 4 per sect at launch (24). Same total power budget as the base disciple of the sect (balance sim must keep win-rate within ±2%). Base disciples of every sect are always free.
pvePower: Heroes are stronger than free disciples in PvE: rarity and star multipliers in pve.json > power (epic x1.35, legendary x1.60, +10% per star up to 10). In PvP every hero uses normalized stats and the rule below.
powerBudgetRule: heroWinRate - baseWinRate within +/-0.02 in headless sim, else rebalance
